name: 급등주매매

rules.scope: PAPER ONLY. Real mode, missing mode, unverified paper account, or non-paper host fails closed at the final order boundary.
rules.rank: ka00198 qry_tp=4 day-cumulative inquiry rank. Not ka10027 gainers. Keep source rank. Filter to date-effective KOSPI200 union KOSDAQ150 and daily return > 0 versus previous regular close.
rules.entry: Verified first surge of the same confirmed event, membership, tradable, daily gain >= 10%. One initial 1,000,000 KRW from 15:18 until regular close. Freshness requires a snapshot observed at or after 15:18, never a future 16:00 snapshot.
rules.fallback: If nothing filled by the close, the next trading day open may buy 1,000,000 KRW only on a gap up that is still above the previous regular close. Partial fills are not missed. No later chase.
rules.adds: Next trading day after the initial fill, +5% adds 1,000,000 and +10% adds another 1,000,000. A jump to +10% executes stage 1 only. At most one add stage per trading day. Reentry may add the same day but does not reset that daily cap.
rules.stops: Return <= -5% sells all but 1 share. Return <= -10% closes the position and wins over every other sell. After a completed add, return strictly below 0% sells all but 1 share.
rules.reentry: After the 1-share stop, one 1,000,000 KRW buy when return crosses to strictly above 0%. A completed -10% close does not reenter.
rules.profit: From 15:15 until the regular close, a positive holding whose developing candle is bearish and whose price crosses below the causal 20-day average exits in full.
rules.telegram: SRG01 configured exits do not wait for pre-loss-sell Telegram approval. Other algorithms keep their own gates. This strategy sends no Telegram.

fill.closingAuctionNote: kt10000 documents no dedicated closing-auction code. 15:20-15:30 uses ordinary limit 0. Market 3 and after-hours 81 are not used in that window.

notes: v2. Rank inquiry for the 급등주 tab runs while trading stays disabled. Paper only. Do not enable RAM01, LDR01, or RCS01 from this spec. Live DB is not updated by this file.
